notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
description:
Activate Temple Bell by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and create a Treasure artifact token for each opponent you have.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Temple Bell.
Repeat.
If you have four or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.
